# `to-spec` skill for agents, and the docs for the spec pane ## What to build A new bundled engine skill, `packages/graph-execution/skills/to-spec/SKILL.md`, that tells a coding agent how to write a spec (PRD) for graph-execution, where to put it, and how the review works. `graph-execution install skills` already copies every folder under `packages/graph-execution/skills/` that has a `SKILL.md` (`packages/graph-execution/src/install/skills.ts`, `bundledSkills()`), so it is installed automatically; update the tests and help text that list the skills. Also: a pointer from `to-tasks` to `to-spec`, a repo-local copy in `.claude/skills/to-spec/`, the engine README's Skills section, graph-manager's README (First steps and The app → Terminals, describing the floating spec pane), and CLAUDE.md step 2. Context for the text (what other tasks build in graph-manager): graph-manager watches each workspace's `docs/prd/*.md` (not `done/`). When a spec is created or changes in the workspace of the focused terminal, a floating pane opens over the Terminals page and shows it live, rendering Markdown and ```` ```mermaid ```` diagrams. It can be dragged, resized and closed, and a `spec ` chip on the terminal's pane head reopens it. There is no status, no approval gate and no approve button: the agent asks the user in the chat. When graph-manager's **Create PR** commits an applied run, it moves the run's spec to `docs/prd/done/` in that commit. Spec: `docs/prd/graph-manager-spec-view.md` (goals 1 and 4, section "Skill and docs"). Read it: its layout (problem, goals with ticket key, a Mermaid flowchart, decision table, non-goals, user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria) is the model the skill describes. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `packages/graph-execution/skills/to-tasks/SKILL.md` — tone, structure and front matter (`name`, `description`) of a bundled skill; section "### 1. Gather context" (line 24) gets one new bullet. - `packages/graph-execution/skills/run-graph/SKILL.md` — the other bundled skill (no change needed). - `.claude/skills/to-tasks/SKILL.md` — this repo's copy of `to-tasks`; keep it identical to the bundled one (ignore the stray `SKILL 2.md` / `validate-tasks 2.mjs` files, do not touch them). - `packages/graph-execution/src/install/skills.test.ts` (lines 20-60) — expects exactly `["run-graph", "to-tasks"]`; becomes `["run-graph", "to-spec", "to-tasks"]` (sorted), installed paths in the same order; `to-spec` contains `["SKILL.md"]`. - `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts` (line 243) — `install skills` description lists `(to-tasks, run-graph)`. - `packages/graph-execution/README.md` (lines 495-530) — "Skills: `graph-execution install skills`". - `apps/graph-manager/README.md` (lines 58-66 "First steps", line 74 the Terminals bullet in "The app"). - `CLAUDE.md` (repo root) — step 2 "Write a spec". ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/skills/to-spec/SKILL.md` - **IMPLEMENT** front matter: ``` --- name: to-spec description: Write a spec (PRD) for graph-execution in docs/prd/.md with a Mermaid diagram of the workflow, then ask the user to read it and approve it or ask for changes. Use when the user wants a spec, PRD or plan for graph-execution, or before to-tasks when there is no spec yet. --- ``` - Body (short, imperative, numbered like `to-tasks`): 1. **Gather** — read the tickets/issue/conversation; explore the code enough to be concrete; ask the user now every question that would otherwise need a human during the run. 2. **Write** `docs/prd/.md` (short kebab-case name; create `docs/prd/` if missing; never inside `docs/prd/done/`). Save early and in a few steps: graph-manager shows the file live next to the terminal while it is written. Sections: Problem; Goals (with ticket keys); a ```` ```mermaid ```` diagram of the workflow or main flow (flowchart, sequence or state, whichever explains the change best; short node labels; quote labels with special characters; check it parses — no HTML other than `
`); Decisions (table: decision, why); Non-goals; User stories; Requirements (concrete files, commands, messages, API shapes); Acceptance criteria (observable checkboxes). 3. **Ask for review** — when done, tell the user the path and ask them to read it (in graph-manager it is already open beside the terminal; elsewhere, any Markdown viewer) and to approve it or say what to change. Apply changes to the file and ask again. Do not continue until the user approves. 4. **Next** — once approved, offer `to-tasks` with this spec, then `run-graph`. When the result is turned into a PR with graph-manager's Create PR, the spec moves to `docs/prd/done/.md` in that commit; outside graph-manager, move it there yourself in the PR. - **GOTCHA**: the skill is copied verbatim into users' projects: no paths of this repository beyond `docs/prd/`, no tickets of this project. ### CREATE `.claude/skills/to-spec/SKILL.md` - Identical copy. ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/skills/to-tasks/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/to-tasks/SKILL.md` - In "### 1. Gather context" add: when there is no spec yet, write one first with the `to-spec` skill and get the user's approval. Keep both copies identical. ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/install/skills.test.ts` and `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts` - Expected lists `["run-graph", "to-spec", "to-tasks"]`; `cli.ts:243` → `Install the bundled skills (to-spec, to-tasks, run-graph) into .agents/skills and/or .claude/skills`. Check `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts` and `README` render tests for the old text (`grep -rn "to-tasks, run-graph" packages`) and update them. ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/README.md` - Skills section: "three bundled skills"; a `**to-spec**` bullet block in the same style as `to-tasks` (where it writes, the Mermaid diagram, review in the chat, the move to `docs/prd/done/` in the PR); the comment `# → .agents/skills/to-spec/, to-tasks/ and run-graph/`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/README.md` - First steps 5: plan with `to-spec` then `to-tasks`; the spec opens in a floating pane next to the terminal while the agent writes it; read it there and answer the agent in the terminal. - The app → Terminals bullet: describe the floating spec pane (auto-opens on a new or changed `docs/prd/*.md` of the focused terminal's workspace, live Markdown + Mermaid, drag/resize/close, `spec ` chip, fills the main area under 900 px). - Run detail / Create PR: Create PR moves the run's spec to `docs/prd/done/` in its commit. ### UPDATE `CLAUDE.md` - Step 2: "Write a spec with the `to-spec` skill in `docs/prd/.md`: the problem, goals with ticket keys, a Mermaid diagram, decisions, non-goals, user stories and acceptance criteria. Ask the user to approve it before writing tasks." Step 8: the spec moves to `docs/prd/done/` in the PR. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `node packages/graph-execution/dist/cli.js install skills` in an empty temp folder installs `run-graph`, `to-spec`, `to-tasks`. - [ ] `diff` shows the bundled and `.claude/skills/` copies of `to-spec` and `to-tasks` `SKILL.md` identical. - [ ] READMEs and CLAUDE.md describe the flow; `npm run build -w graph-execution` still renders the README. - [ ] `npm test -w graph-execution -- src/install` passes. ## Validation commands ```bash npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-execution -- src/install for s in to-spec to-tasks; do diff packages/graph-execution/skills/$s/SKILL.md .claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md; done npm run build -w graph-execution ```
